mapper.select: select storage.PRJ_ID as prjId,a.NAME as prjName, storage.STAGE_ID as stageId,e.NAME as stageName, storage.SUB_ITEM_ID as subItemId,b.NAME as subItemName, storage.PROFESSION_ID as professionId,f.NAME as professionName, storage.ID as fId,storage.PARENT_ID as fParentId,storage.NAME as fName,storage.TYPE as fType from BIZ_CAD_STORAGE storage left join BIZ_CAD_PROJECT a on a.ID = storage.PRJ_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_SUB_ITEM b on b.ID = storage.SUB_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_STAGE e on e.ID = storage.STAGE_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_PROFESSION f on f.ID = storage.PROFESSION_ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}

SELECT t2.* FROM ( SELECT @r AS _id, (SELECT @r := PARENT_ID FROM BIZ_CAD_STORAGE WHERE ID = _id) AS parent_id, @l := @l + 1 AS lvl FROM (SELECT @r := ${fileId}, @l := 0) vars, BIZ_CAD_STORAGE AS h WHERE @r != '' and @r is not null ) t1 JOIN BIZ_CAD_STORAGE t2 ON t1._id = t2.ID ORDER BY t1.lvl DESC

select a.PRJ_ID as prjId,b.NAME as prjName, a.STAGE_ID as stageId,c.NAME as stageName, a.SUB_ITEM_ID as subItemId,d.NAME as subItemName, a.PROFESSION_ID as professionId,e.NAME as professionName, c.SORT_INDEX as stageIndex,e.SORT_INDEX as professionIndex from BIZ_CAD_STORAGE a LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_PROJECT b on b.ID = a.PRJ_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_STAGE c on c.ID = a.STAGE_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_SUB_ITEM d on d.ID = a.SUB_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_PROFESSION e on e.ID = a.PROFESSION_ID where a.ID = #{storageId}
